chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Kūfī narrated from Mūsā ibn ʿImrān al-Nakhaʿī, from his uncle al-Ḥusayn ibn Yazīd, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from his father, from Yaḥyā ibn Abī al-Qāsim, from al-Ṣādiq Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from his grandfather, peace be upon them, who said:

The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “The Imams after me are twelve. The first of them is ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib, and the last of them is al-Qāʾim. They are my successors, my trustees, my authorities, and the proofs of Allah over my ummah after me. The one who acknowledges them is a believer, and the one who denies them is a disbeliever.”

key_terms.أَوْصِيَائِي: My trustees or legatees; those entrusted with the Prophet’s bequest.
key_terms.أَوْلِيَائِي: My authorities or guardians; those vested with wilayah after him.
key_terms.اثْنَا عَشَرَ: Twelve; the specified number of Imams in the narration.
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: The Imams, the divinely designated leaders after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: Al-Qāʾim, the final Imam who will rise by Allah’s command.
key_terms.الْمُقِرُّ بِهِمْ: The one who affirms and acknowledges them.
key_terms.حُجَجُ اللَّهِ: The proofs of Allah; those through whom divine authority is established over creation.
key_terms.خُلَفَائِي: My successors; those who come after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله with rightful authority.

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of the twelve Imams say about their authority after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله؟
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Imams after the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله are twelve, beginning with ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام and ending with al-Qāʾim عليه السلام. It presents them as the Prophet’s successors, trustees, and Allah’s proofs over the ummah, making recognition of them a mark of faith and rejection of them a sign of disbelief.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5406 - Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah Al-Kufi narrated from Musa ibn Imran Al-Nakhai from his uncle Al-Husayn ibn Yazid from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from his father from Yahya ibn Abi Al-Qasim from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), from his grandfather Imam Hussain ibn Ali (as), peace be upon them all, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"The Imams (as) after me are twelve.
The first of them is Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), and the last of them is the Riser (Al-Qaʾim (as)).
They are my successors, my trustees, my guardians, and the proofs of Allah (swt) over my nation after me.
Whoever acknowledges them is a believer, and whoever denies them is a disbeliever."
